skill_name: Compare and contrast the impact of the 5th century BCE in China and India.
workflow: The 5th century BCE saw both India and China undergoing significant changes in culture, religion, politics, and society. In China, the aristocratic Zhou dynasty was replaced by the monarchy and bureaucracy of the Qin dynasty, leading to an increase in the centralized power of the emperor. In India, the Gupta Empire was formed, which saw an increase in Hindu and Buddhist influence and an overall prosperous period for the region in terms of art, literature and science.
